description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeReportingMethodDao component of the OrangeHRM's PIM plugin. It includes setup procedures, multiple unit tests for DAO methods such as retrieving, searching, saving, and deleting employee reporting relations, as well as assertions to validate expected behaviors.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeReportingMethodDao, testing methods related to employee reporting structures within the HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO object and populates test data fixtures before each test run.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers_WhenReportToAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieving report-to information when it exists for given employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers_WhenReportToNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieval when report-to data is not available for specified employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount_WhenSubordinatesAvailable
methods.description: Verifies subordinate count retrieval when subordinates exist for a given employee.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount_WhenSubordinatesNotAvailable
methods.description: Verifies subordinate count retrieval when no subordinates exist for a given employee.

methods.name: testGetSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount_WhenSupervisorsAvailable
methods.description: Tests counting of immediate supervisors when they are present.

methods.name: testGetSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount_WhenSupervisorsNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests counting of immediate supervisors when none are present.

methods.name: testSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors_WhenSupervisorsNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieval of immediate supervisors when there are none.

methods.name: testSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors_WhenSupervisorsAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieval of immediate supervisors when they are available.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSubordinates_WhenSubordinatesAvailable
methods.description: Validates retrieval of subordinates for an employee when data exists.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSubordinates_WhenSubordinatesNotAvailable
methods.description: Validates retrieval when no subordinates are present.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeReportTo_WithSupervisor
methods.description: Tests saving a reporting relationship with a supervisor.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeReportTo_WithSubordinate
methods.description: Tests saving a reporting relationship with a subordinate.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Verifies deletion of supervisor relationships for an employee.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Verifies deletion of subordinate relationships for an employee.
